Every value here was measured or derived MODEL-FREE at registration, before any contact: the composed and protocol hashes through core.config.compose / core.config.protocol_hash, the Solver fragment seed through rails.runner._solver_fragment_seed, the roster facts from the committed Fold A roster receipt's own items, and the Fold A artifact pins copied verbatim out of the sealed Fold A lock baseline. accounting.ceiling_arithmetic: 20,520 = 1,080 TRAIN Fold A rows x 19 and 76 = 4 rows x 19, where 19 is the grouped-Solver graph's OWN ceiling at samples 5 as rails.native_episode_config.load_native_episode_config resolves it: perception.max_iterations + (max_revisions + 1) x (solver.max_iterations x solver.samples + reviewer.max_iterations + planner.max_iterations) = 1 + 2 x (1 x 5 + 3 + 1) = 19. Verified offline at registration: the composed program phase-native-candidates-review-revise-samples5-v1 declares max_contacts 19 and the loader's own graph ceiling resolves to 19 (a disagreement is refused by name). FIT: 82,080 = 20,520 x (1 speech packet + 3 endpoints) and 304 = 76 x 4 -- cell ROLL-1's own native_contact_fit mode and multiplier, rescaled to this roster.

expected_cost.note: About 8.5 contacts per row, so about 9,234 contacts and about 3.5 GPU hours on the arm. Basis: cell ROLL-1 MEASURED 8.5504 contacts per row on this exact grouped-Solver form (samples 5, temperature 0.7, min_support 3) over 625 R01C rows, and nothing in this registration changes the role graph, the prompt form or the number of scheduled requests -- only the roster the same form runs on. 8.5 x 1,080 = 9,180 and 8.5504 x 1,080 = 9,234, so the registered ceiling of 20,520 is about 2.2x the expectation and the 12.0 GPU-hour ceiling about 3.4x it. A ceiling is a BOUND, never a target, and budgets are run-cumulative across every attempt of a run id.

accounting.family_scope: FOUR registered rows, all flight identities (arm generation + fit, smoke generation + fit). The decision receipt coordination/slurp-stage3-roll-2-fold-a-v1/root-admission-v1.json (decision id slurp-stage3-roll-2-fold-a-admission-v1) lists those FOUR run ids as eligible_run_ids. The descriptive read over the sealed pool (SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-ROLL-2-FOLD-A-READ-V1) is registered separately, after the seal, before any number is read.
accounting.speech_arithmetic: 58,607 = ceil(3084.5284375 x 19) on the 1,080 arm rows and 202 = ceil(10.5955625 x 19) on the four smoke rows. The per-row audio seconds are read from the committed Fold A roster receipt's own items[].audio_seconds (and agree with the Fold A dataset fragment's declared audio_seconds_total); no audio sample was decoded to obtain them.

The only 0.67 pp instrument the program has is an offline read over one sealed sample pool, and that pool exists on R01C but NOT on the lock roster. This cell creates the missing pool.
